Title: Retirement: Upgrade from Azure API Management stv1 to stv2 by Aug. 31, 2024

Body.Content:
The August 31st deadline to upgrade from Azure API Management stv1 to stv2 is rapidly approaching. After this date, your stv1 platform will no longer receive the latest updates and additional features available in stv2. 

The stv2 platform’s advancements make it a valuable upgrade for users seeking to enhance their API management capabilities and ensure future support. For a full breakdown of the differences between stv1 and stv2, check out our comparison overview. Remember, completing the migration before the retirement date is essential to avoid service disruptions and to take advantage of the new features and improvements offered by stv2. 

For a detailed guide on the migration process, you can refer to our official documentation. We also have a helpful Azure Experts on Demand video to walk viewers through the upgrade process. We're here to help you migrate to the stv2 platform with minimal disruptions to your services. If you have questions, get fast answers from community experts in Microsoft Q&A. If you have a support plan and you need technical help, create a support request.

Learn more.
